library_id.description: Limit retrieval to sources in this library. Pass the same id to repository search and file read. Omit to search every ready source.

limit.description: Maximum number of ranked chunks to return. Defaults to 10, capped at 20.

query.description: Natural-language search query. Runs hybrid (semantic + full-text) retrieval over all SAFE, READY knowledge chunks in this project.

rerank.description: Rerank results with an LLM pass for better relevance. Defaults to true. Falls back to fused rank order when the rerank fails. Pass false for a faster search.
